title: ZcashFoundation Zebra zebrad before 7.0.0 contains a reachable assertion race condition that allows unauthenticated…
description: ZcashFoundation Zebra zebrad versions before 7.0.0 have a reachable assertion race condition that allows unauthenticated remote peers to abort the node. This occurs when malicious peers trigger disconnection during a blocked outbound send by returning empty FindBlocks or FindHeaders replies and ceasing to read their socket, causing syncing nodes to terminate.
